definitions.explanation: A formal/literary honorific prefix, more elevated than お or ご.

examples.japanese: {御礼|おんれい}⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
{御社|おんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{祈|いの}りします→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: I wish for your company's prosperity.

notes:
{御|おん}〜 is a formal/literary honorific prefix, more elevated than お〜 or ご〜.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {御礼|おんれい}: gratitude, thanks (formal)
- {御社|おんしゃ}: your company (in business correspondence)
- {御中|おんちゅう}: used when addressing organizations in letters
- {御名|おんな}: your name (archaic/formal)

USAGE NOTE:
This prefix is quite formal and often appears in:
- Business correspondence
- Formal documents
- Historical/literary texts
- Religious contexts

COMPARISON OF HONORIFIC PREFIXES:
- お〜: standard polite (お{名前|なまえ})
- ご〜: polite for Sino-Japanese (ご{住所|じゅうしょ})
- {御|おん}〜: formal/literary ({御礼|おんれい})
